title: Data Mining
description: An introduction to data mining. Data preparation, model building, and data mining techniques such as clustering, decisions trees and neural networks are discussed and applied to case studies. Data-mining software tools are reviewed and compared.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SENG 474, CSC 503, CSC 578D (if taken in same topic), ECE 311.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
